branch_policy: Formal generated-Danchi candidates must reconstruct and validate the complete outdoor-unit installation before fan-face replacement and before any Danchi LOD proxy is generated. This source/scene contract awards zero Visual Fidelity points without actual native render evidence.
formal_build_order: reopen Assets/Scenes/QualityBlock1990s.unity from the persisted installation state
ordering_reason: The installation pass must see the legacy HD_AC_FanDisc, HD_AC_FanHub and grille children because those casing-mounted details are translated with the mechanically corrected chassis elevation.

The installation pass reconstructs refrigerant lines and the condensate drain from the moved unit-side interfaces to fixed wall/slab interfaces; applying it after fan replacement would leave the formal build dependent on ordering accidents.
Physical rotor/shroud, circular-wire guard and guard-to-shroud mounting feet are then authored against the corrected persisted unit location.
LOD proxy generation is last so every proxy is derived from the same mechanically valid source assembly rather than from a partly corrected or late-overlay state.

components: fixed facade penetration collar and clips
four physical galvanized guard mounting feet
interfaces_and_load_path: balcony slab -> mounting plate -> support foot -> condenser chassis
condenser unit-side refrigerant outlets -> continuous bent/segmented insulated lines -> fixed wall collar
condenser low drain outlet -> descending hose -> terminal held positively above balcony surface
fan guard -> four galvanized mounting feet -> molded intake shroud
orientation_exposure_aging: casing front/top are midsummer sun/rain exposed while grille recesses remain darker through geometry and occlusion rather than painted shading
plates/feet/fasteners are slab-contact and splash-zone hardware; oxidation/grime is localized by contact and exposure causality
refrigerant insulation ages more strongly near the exposed unit than at the sheltered wall interface
drain wetness/residue is permitted only near the low condensate outlet/discharge path
guard and guard mounts inherit ferrous/UV/rain exposure; arbitrary rust added only for visibility is forbidden

material_microdetail_only: galvanized dulling and fine zinc mottling
forbidden_shortcuts: floating supports or guard mounts hidden by dark material
weathering decals used to conceal interpenetration

aged_ac_plastic.wetness: normally dry; exposure-driven rain spotting only
aged_ac_plastic.angular_response: broad dielectric edge response; no painted hot edge

galvanized_hardware.uv_aging: minimal hue shift; oxidation primarily changes roughness/value
galvanized_hardware.angular_response: metallic grazing response dulled by oxidation; round guard curvature is physical geometry

pipe_insulation.wetness: small rain-darkened patches only on exposed runs

drain_hose.wetness: darker terminal region allowed only from condensate causality

lod_policy.lod0: complete construction master including supports, bolts, service lines, fan/shroud, round-wire guard and guard mounts
lod_policy.lod1: retain support/service silhouettes, fan hub, round-wire guard and guard mounts; micro fasteners may drop
lod_policy.lod2: thin support/service/guard hardware may drop before sub-pixel shimmer; medium fan rotor and macro intake/casing read remain subject to the existing classifier
lod_policy.lod3: only macro/silhouette features retained by the Danchi classifier; no exposed primitive placeholder is permitted in benchmark framing
lod_policy.transition: animated cross-fade required; native temporal evidence required before awarding stability points

critical_defect_mapping: visible primitive-placeholder geometry in benchmark framing
failure_injection_when_runner_available: delete one support foot or plate and require final Danchi validation failure
offset one casing vertically outside the 2-10 mm chassis/foot embed and require failure
break one refrigerant segment joint beyond 4 mm and require failure
move one drain endpoint outside the 5-20 mm positive slab-clearance range and require failure
remove one wall/service interface component and require construction validation failure
after a clean formal baseline, mutate a validated installation renderer/transform and require reflection/render-state evidence binding failure rather than repair

inspect: dielectric casing versus galvanized hardware grazing response
LOD transition pop and wire/service-line shimmer
